# Plan: per-client rate limiting

1. Implement a sliding one-minute window per client in src/limiter.js: allow(client, now) returns false after 10 requests.
2. Call allow(request.client, Date.now()) in src/server.js before normal handling and return 429 when it is false; leave /health unchanged.
3. Add test/limiter.test.mjs covering the 10th and 11th request and window expiry, and extend test/server.test.mjs to confirm /health is never limited.

## Risks

- Unbounded growth of per-client state: detect with a test that expires old windows; prune entries older than a minute.
- Clock skew in tests: pass `now` explicitly instead of reading the clock inside the limiter.
